title: Posterior Thigh Stroking
summary: Smooth passes over the back of the thigh while avoiding pressure behind the knee.
goal: Gently warm the posterior thigh muscles.
startingPosition: The person lies face down with the leg relaxed.
instructions: Begin above the back of the knee.
Glide upward over the posterior thigh.
Do not press behind the knee.
Reduce pressure near the gluteal fold.
warning: Do not massage with acute pain, recent injury, marked swelling, or inflammation. One-sided swelling, redness, warmth, or calf pain should be medically assessed before massage.
